title: Watloop Island Light Railway
safeHtml:
Watloop Island Light Railway is the Light Rail System on Watloop Island. It is ran by StarTop Railway.

Station List[]

Currently, Watloop Island Light Railway has one line with six stations as follows:

  • Taipa-loop Line:
    • San-loop Station (Interchange with Nazca Railway Stadow Line, SLT Line 510L)
    • Gondola Hotel Station
    • Watloop Beach Station
    • Shimizu Beacon Station
    • Shopping Street Station
    • Watloop Circle Station

After Watloop Circle Station, Taipa-loop Line will go back to San-loop Station.

History[]

  • March 8 2017: This station began operations.
  • 2019: This station was temporary closed due to Deepond Light Rail reformation.
  • March 15 2023: This station was reopened with operation of Line 5.
  • May 27 2025: Line 2 began operations, and the lifts of this station were put in use.
  • July 24 2025: Deepond Light Rail Line 2 extends to Deepond School, and Through Service to Kau Po is terminated.

Fun Facts[]

  • Based on island owner's description, the station name is exactly from Watorest Station of Nazca Railway Terracept Division in remembrance of Terracept (Which is not yet reopened in 2017).
  • While its English name is confirmed and will not change, its Chinese name however changed from "森水" to "林水南", and to "林水" in 2021, due to the fact that "森水" is the Chinese name of Luxter Line and "南" (South) is not necessary if original name doesn't exist.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Noctilune Expanse.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Where Cold Order Moves and Night Becomes String".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is named after waxing, which refers to Moon appearing larger each night as a progression from the New Moon to the Full Moon. As a result, a Mural that includes all Lunar Phases except for the New Moon is featured at the Concourse of this Station.

History[]

  • October 21 2025: This Station began construction.
  • October 23 2025: This Station completed construction.
  • October 25 2025: This station began services.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station, along with Spinstone Plane Station, are stations that are related to Weaving. Magenta Wool is used in this station as this station alludes to Spinstone Plane Station, and a similar color to Pink is ideally used.[2]
  • The Circular Wheel of this station refers to Looms in Fairy Tales, which usually involve a circular structure.[3] As a result, this station features the first ever circular concourse in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • Platform 1 of this Station is directly connected to Exits A and B of this station.
  • This station features a Circular Staircase at Exit C.

History[]

  • August 26 2017: This station began services.
  • February 16 2019: Exit C is added to this station to connect to the StarTop Railway Station of the Same Name.[4]
  • April 6 2026: Exit D is added to this station.[5]

Welliant Plateau Station is a station on Cometsilk Line and Starshore Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Prymea.

Fun Facts[]

  • At the time of the Construction of this Station, it was located at Starshore. However, following the establishment of Prymea as District Number 26 on May 4, Starshore was merged by Prymea and no longer exists.
  • The design of this station corresponds to Oldon Town Station of Wanderer Line due to their concourses using a high ceiling height and the full platform length, as well as the Patterns.[2]

History[]

  • January 22 2022: This station completed construction.[3]
  • January 23 2022: This station began services alongside Cometsilk Line.
  • April 18 2026: This Station began expansion of the Starshore Line Part.
  • April 22 2026: This station completed expansion of the Starshore Line Part, but as Starshore Line is not yet connected to another station, Platforms 3, 4 remain reserved.
  • April 26 2026: Starshore Line extends from Nail Bight Checkpoint to this station through Rougewood Station. Starshore Line is established.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station, alongside Nightcord Station and Winter Point Gateway, are all interchange stations of Asylum Line and Snowty Line. This is the third set[2] of "Triplet Interchanges" in Nazca Railway, with the first two sets being Hartasy Line, Wardring Line and West Ring Line, Luxter Line respectively[3]. However, unlike the previous sets, which adopted the standard rule of having one station for same direction, opposite direction, and inter-floor interchanges, this set of triplet interchanges had two stations that are of opposite directions[4] and one station with the same direction being this station.

History[]

  • January 9 2026: This Station began construction.
  • January 11 2026: This Station completed construction.
  • January 13 2026: This station began services alongside Snowty Line, but Asylum Line Platforms remain reserved.

title: West Metropolis Archipelago
safeHtml:
West Metropolis Archipelago (Abbreviated as WMA) is the coined term for a total of 147 Islands that lay on the sea between Los Sengas Continent, Peckern Continent and Twenty-Second Continent. It is named after the fact that the islands lay to the west of Los Sengas Downtown. The representative color of the WMA in Los Sengas is Light Blue, and the District Number is 5.

Description[]

The WMA mainly consists of a vast ocean, with islands being scattered across the sea. Multiple lines of Nazca Railway cross the WMA using underwater tunnels, but this area is also mainly served by the Nazca Ferry. Moreover, multiple routes and trunk roads pass under the ocean between the islands. Therefore, despite being mainly consisted of the sea, this area could still be seen as an important transport node in Los Sengas. The Regulations for Highly Permitted Island Development also ensured that players who are qualified regardless of status could also develop their own islands. As a result, this area is one of the most actively developed areas in Los Sengas.

List of Islands and Sub-Districts[]

Main article: List of West Metropolis Archipelago Islands

It should be noted that while Centopia to the southwest is also an island, it belongs to a separate district and does not belong to the WMA.

West Oasis Bay Line was Line Number 17T of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. This line ran between Europa and Tat Stone Hill. It was established alongside Dumbbell Plateau Station on February 12 2019. However, on December 22 that same year, this line merged with Oasis Bay Line, and West Oasis Bay Line was abolished. On January 24 2020, the two sections of Oasis Bay Line had connected with each other.

Description []

West Oasis Bay Line was one of the Auxiliary lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It ran along Jupiter.

This route was represented by Light Green Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 17T.

History[]

  • S3E4: Europa - Tat Stone Hill
  • S3E8 (Merger with Oasis Bay Line): Europa - Southern Heights

Line Charcteristics[]

  • At the time of its operation, this line was one of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • Express Services of this line when it was still in operation:
    • Epsilon Line (West, now named Echo Line): Europa to Tat Stone Hill.

Fun Facts[]

  • This line was formerly a part of the west section of Oasis Bay Line , but as the west and east sections were not connected at the time of its construction, this Temporary line was established, hence the letter T after the line number.
  • This line shared colors with Oasis Bay Line.
  • At the time of this line's existence, this line was widely regarded as a branch line of Oasis Bay Line. However, in Nazca Railway official documents, West Oasis Bay Line was seen as a part of Oasis Bay Line, except that naming and numbering of this line needed to be separate from the main Oasis Bay Line for identification purposes. In other words, when thsi line merged with Oasis Bay Line, it was in fact two separate sections of the same line connecting together.

West Ring Line is the first line in NR Los Sengas Division to commence services and complete. It is a circular line that serves west Los Sengas. With 37 stations along the route, West Ring Line has the third highest number of stations among all the Los Sengas Division railway lines (behind Stadium Line and East Ring Line). The first section of this route between Metropolis and Greenrock Hill commenced services on March 16 2015, with the whole line completing works on September 29 2015, with a station (Metro Stone Station) being added along the line on August 27 2016.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 History

    • 2.2 Crossing the Seas (West Ring Line extension to Peckern Mainland)

Description[]

West Ring Line is the first line in NR to be established. It travels through Downtown, Sava, The Western Metropolis Archipelago (WMA), Peckern, Airship Island, Twenty-Second Continent and TriPaw Peninsula, before going back to Metropolis Terminal through the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals.

This line is represented by Red on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 1.

Currently, this route is 57.895 km long, with a total of 37 stations (Among the 37 stations, 20 are interchanges).

History[]

  • S1E1: Metropolis - Sava Coast
  • S1E2: Metropolis - Bufly Island
  • S1E5: Metropolis - Caver Island
  • S1E6: South Bay - Caver Island
  • S1E9: South Bay - Peckern Forest
  • S1E10: South Bay - Treeless Hill
  • S1E12: Miner North - Treeless Hill
  • S1E13: Miner North - Wood Wound
  • S1E14: Sheung Che Nung - Wood Wound
  • S1E15: Metropolis - Metropolis (Loop Complete)
  • S2E6: Metropolis - Metropolis (Inner Ring via Metro Stone)
  • S3E11: Metropolis - Metropolis (Outer Ring via Metro Stone)

Route Establishment (Birth of West Ring Line)[]

West Ring Line appeared with Metropolis Terminal on March 15 2015, and is the first route in Los Sengas. This line entered services alongside Greenrock Hill Station on March 16. The first section of development sees West Ring Line connecting Downtown with Sava. Subsequent Development of the line saw it extending to the WMA on April 6 with the commencement of services for Bufly Island Station, where it interchanges with Luxter Line.

Crossing the Seas (West Ring Line extension to Peckern Mainland)[]

One month later, on May 11, NR once again extends West Ring Line, and the northern terminus of the lines was changed to Caver Island Station, also located in the WMA, before reaching the new southern terminus of South Bay Station alongside Urban Line on May 30, which is located at the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals.

Reunion at another Continent (Convergence of West Ring Line and Stadium Line)[]

Later, NR made an extension to the west of the WMA for Stadium Line by mid-June, and works were carried out for it to converge with West Ring Line. On July 7, West Ring Line reached Gull Woods Station on Peckern Continent, and by July 15, it extended to Peckern Forest Station alongside Stadium Line.

After the two lines converged, NR built a six-station triangular interchange system for the West Ring Line, Stadium Line and a new line named Daring Line. Among the six stations involved, West Ring Line passed through Wativer Station and Treeless Hill Station, both of which involved interchanging with Daring Line.

Progress more than half (Progressing to Ring Completion)[]

West Ring Line reaching Treeless Hill Station signified that West Ring Line works are now more than 50% complete. As a result, NR temporarily suspended further works for this line on S1E11 in order to construct Rover Down Checkpoint. Then, after half a month of zero progress, to facilitate development of the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals, West Ring Line extended southwards from South Bay Station to Numpool Station and Miner North Station, before further extending the terminus on the Peckern Side to Wood Wound Station.

Subsequently, West Ring Line extended from the Tripaw Peninsula to Sheung Che Nung Station of the Twenty-Second Continent in S1E14. By then, the only section left unconstructed was the one between Sheung Che Nung Station and Wood Wound Station.

Ring Completion[]

In S1E15, West Ring Line extended into Airship Island territory and entered Twenty-Second Continent. In the process of connecting to Sheung Che Nung Station, West Ring Line also passed through Comp Ward Station and Comic Ward Station, which reserved room for interchanges with New Edward Line, Alpha Line and Kinight Line respectively.

With the opening of Tai Nung Plains Station on September 29 2015, West Ring Line has finally formed a complete loop, and hence became the first line to complete development.

Subsequent Development[]

On August 27 2016, Metro Stone Station was added between Metropolis Terminal and Greenrock Hill Station for the Inner Ring Direction, where the Metro Stone Railway Building was constructed. On May 17 2020, the Outer Ring Direction also stops at this station.

It should be noted that the above denotes the order for the Inner Ring Direction. The order is reversed for the Outer Ring Direction.

Line Charcteristics[]

  • This line is the first line to complete development in the Los Sengas Division.
  • This line is the first circular line to complete development in Nazca Railway.
  • This line was formerly the line with the most stations along the route (Since overtaken by Stadium Line and East Ring Line) and the second longest route (Since overtaken by East Ring Line).
  • This line passes through the West Metropolis Archipelago three times and has 9 stations in it.
  • The Miner Bay Depot along this route could store up to 630 carriages of vehicles, and was once the largest depot in NR (Since overtaken by Vector Bay Depot of East Ring Line), but it is still the third largest depot in NR.
  • Express Services of this line:
    • Alpha Line (West): Metropolis to Comp Ward
    • Fox Line (West): Metropolis to Wativer
    • Lima Line (West): Metropolis to Sava Coast

Fun Facts[]

  • This line is the first line to be established in Season 1, as well as the Los Sengas Division as a whole.
  • West Ring Line is the first line to complete development in the Los Sengas Division, and is also the first circular line to complete development throughout NR history.[1]
  • Metro Stone Station is the first station to be inserted between two existing stations for both West Ring Line and the Los Sengas Division, and was once the only station that serves one direction of any given line in the Los Sengas Division. However, once the outer ring platform for this station was completed in S3E11, this characteristic disappeared.
  • A special set of track spurs are seen before High Approach Station and after Pisces Pond Station.
  • A soundproof barrier is built between Sava Coast Station and Sava Canyon Station after the sound barrier in Katadelphia for New Edward Line received positive feedback.
  • West Ring Line is the first main line to serve the West Metropolis Archipelago (WMA).
  • Upper Bufly Tunnel, located between Bufly Island Station and Droplet Island Station, is 2560m long, and used to be the longest underwater, until the record was broken by the Route 5 Tunnel (West Section) which is used by Fox Line and is approximately 6.5km long.
  • A spur is built to connect the "West Ring Line - East Ring Line - Urban Line - Luxter Line - Flask Line - Minecraft Line - Ingress Line" system tracks with the "New Edward Line - Stadium Line - Arcgo Line - Origin Line" system tracks at the aboveground section before Peckern Pond Station for the Outer Ring Direction of West Ring Line and the Up direction of Stadium Line. While these two systems intersect at Metropolis Terminal, the tracks are not connected. However, a second set of connecting tracks were later built between Kelper Mount Station and Litchi Lake Station.
  • The section between Pan-ward Station and Comic Ward Station, located in Twenty-Second Continent, was shaped as a Question Mark (?).
  • A West Ring Line Completion Memorial was erected at Tai Nung Plains Station, where the completion ceremony was also held. However, a memorial featuring all stations of the West Ring Line, was also seen at Airship Island Station.
  • Miner Bay Depot, located between Miner North Station and Szeman Island Station, used to be the largest Depot in Los Sengas and NR.
  • The track section between Numpool Station (Exclusive) and Miner North Station (Exclusive) were sealed due to the Charlie Line extension.

West Shoal Checkpoint is a checkpoint on West Ring Line, Luxter Line, Sava Line and Phoenix Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Sava. Passengers may also use this station to change to NR Buses Route R20A, SLT Line 202, Line 203, Line 205 West Shoal and SLT Line 202 West Shoal East Stops.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

  • Just go to the Station Souvenir, Station Gauntlet Passageway Floor to get your Station Souvenir.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of Sand.

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2-2.5
  • Inside the Challenge Area are four buttoms. Press the buttons in accordance to the first three signs scattered across the Station.[10] Click the buttons according to the order of the signs, and find the exit using the last sign.
  • Take note of the details and differences in the four signs.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of Sand.

Fun Facts[]

  • This page is the 2700th page of this wiki.
  • The design of this station pays tribute to South Point Station of the Terracept Division.
  • The West Concourse has been slightly expanded to accommodate the Los Sengas Coffee and lavatories during the Upgrading Works.[11]
  • The West Ring Line, Luxter Line Platforms in this Station were formerly the longest platforms in Nazca Railway at 505m long. However, this record has since been taken over by Swamp One Station of Flask Line, and despite this, only the west side of the platforms of this station are used for boarding, and the east side is only glass walls.
  • The West Ring Line, Luxter Line Platforms in this Station is the first pair of platforms in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division to be longer than the Standard Length of 204m.
  • This Station is the first station to use platforms with curved ends. This configuration is to facilitate the Crossover Sidings to the west of this station for West Ring Line and Luxter Line.
  • This Station is the first station in Los Sengas Division to feature more than one concourse.
  • This station is the last station to undergo expansion in Season 3.
  • This station was formerly an Area Station, but after the arrival of Sava Line and Phoenix Line to this station, it became a Checkpoint.
  • The Paper of West Shoal is a special souvenir that could only be obtained from this station.
  • This Checkpoint is the first Checkpoint that does NOT involve Veloducts or Express Lines.
  • This Station is the permanent Down Direction Terminus of Sava Line.
  • While Exit E of this station was formerly connected directly to Platforms 2, 4 using a long staircase, after the arrival of Sava Line and Phoenix Line, it has been rebuilt and now connects to the East Concourse instead. The Exit E concourse at the East ends of Platforms 1-4 has since been demolished.
  • According to the Station Tour Clip of this station, which was filmed before this station became a Checkpoint, this station already had plans to expand at the time of its construction as the longer platforms are built for reserved future expansion use. The future expansion has since been confirmed to feature a new Concourse and two additional lines.[12]

History[]

  • April 4 2015: This station began operations alongside West Ring Line and Luxter Line. Luxter Line is established.
  • February 16 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[13]
  • December 24 2016: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[14]
  • May 19 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[15]
  • January 6 2021: The Luxter Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[16]
  • March 15 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[17]
  • April 11 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[18]
  • December 14 2022: Nazca Railway announces that Sava Line and Phoenix Line will pass through this station.[19]
  • June 15 2023: This station became a Checkpoint.
  • June 25 2023: This station completed expansion.
  • June 26 2023: Phoenix Line extends from Evergarden Station to this station.
  • June 27 2023: Sava Line extends from Lotusville Station to this station. Sava Line Completed Construction.

title: Whitecliff Village Stabling Sidings
safeHtml:
Whitecliff Village Stabling Sidings is one of the stabling sidings of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for East Ring Line. It is located to the south of Whitecliff Village Station. This Stabling Siding is designed to support Miner Bay Depot, Vector Bay Depot and Quarter Basin Stabling Sidings, and is estimated to have a capacity of up to 16 nine-carriage trains.

Contents

  • 1 Description
    • 1.1 Sidings
    • 1.2 Connecting Tracks
    • 1.3 Other Facts
  • 2 Gallery
  • 3 Citations and References

Description[]

Sidings[]

The two sides have eight sidings each, which can store 16 trains.

Connecting Tracks[]

The two ends of the stabling sidings connect to East Ring Line, with access to Daisy Island Station to the west and Sunflower Garden Station to the east.

Other Facts[]

Besides of increasing the capacity for East Ring Line, this Stabling Siding is also constructed with enhancing East Ring Line dispatch frequencies in mind. This Stabling Siding is located on ground level, and high walls are set up around this stabling siding to prevent breaches into this Stabling Siding and causing potential danger. The trains parked in this Stabling Siding are also managed by Vector Bay Depot.

Description[]

Location and Exterior[]

Whitemart is located at the northeasterly side of Leben Island to the south side of Yigeoi Street directly opposite to the East Outdoor Grocery Mall. It is two storeys high and features three separate sets of entrances, with one set at the west, one set at the north and one set at the east.

First Floor[]

The First Floor of this Supermart features a shopping area that features a total of 26 racks of goods and 30 isles. Each Rack contains 20 columns of goods, and each isle at the center and the edges provide access to 10 columns and 20 columns respectively. It is also connected to the ground floor by elevator and escalators.

Ground Floor[]

The Ground Floor of this Supermart houses the entrances and parking lot of this Supercenter, as well as another Shopping Area, the Whitemart Pharmacy and the Los Sengas Coffee.

The west entrance is entry only, whereas the north entrance and east entrance are for visitors with vehicles that are visiting the store and performing Online Pick-Up respectively. However, the east entrance can also be used for visitors who want to visit the superstore, albeit with lower capacity.

The Parking lot for this Supercenter is located to the northeast of the building structure of Whitemart. In total, it features 45 normal parking spaces, four parking spaces for Online Pick-up Users and a Pick-Up and Drop-Off Area that is marked with blue lines. It also provides access to the Loading and Unloading Area of the Whitemart.

The Online Pick-Up Area is located at the east side of the building. It features three different counters and is designed in an orange motif, unlike the rest of Whitemart which has a white color scheme. It also provides staff access to the Loading and Unloading Area located to the east of the Building.

Whitemart Pharmacy is located directly to the south of the Online Pick-Up area. It provides four different counters and a rack for medicine. It is also directly connected to the Loading and Unloading Area, and sells Golden Apples, Enchanted Golden Apples, Potions of Strength, Dragon's Breath, Potions of Instant Health and Potions of Protection.

The shopping area is located at the center area of this building. Besides of six smaller racks in the same style as the ones on the First Floor, larger racks with 16 columns, 18 columns and 24 columns are also seen, which in turn surrounds the eleavtor and escalator access to the First Floor, as well as booths that displays Pastries and Fresh Produce. The north end of this building features the Check-Out Area with 8 self-serving counters and 6 staffed check-out Counters.

The Los Sengas Coffee is located at the Southeast Corner of this building and serves the same goods as Los Sengas Coffess in Nazca Railway stations.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Supercenter is built in the style of Walmart.
  • The name of this Supercenter pays tribute to White Market Station of the now-defunct Heaven Pacific Division of Nazca Railway.
  • Although Whitemart is a supercenter specifically designed for Leben Island, this supercenter is now also seen in Jupiter, with two other supercenters set at Tat Stone Hill and Stamford.

Whitestone Village Station is a station on Stadium Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Festival. Passengers may also use this station to change to Haruna City Railway Reiher Line, Reiher Express (Whitestone Village Station).

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Alabaster Oceanfront.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Gleams Between the Rails".

Alabaster Oceanfront 02:33

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is currently the westernmost station in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • This Station is Sister Stations with Blackstone Village Station.
  • As the western half of this station is located above the sea, the Concourse is only half the length of the Platform.

History[]

  • July 1 2021: The Platforms of this station completed construction.[4] At the same day, this station began services.
  • March 7 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • October 24 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this station alludes to Wall Street.[2]
  • Despite being near Metro River Station, Wilde Street, the street at which this station is located, will become a commercial center in the fashion similar to Wall Street. As a result, this station is set up to cater for the potential increase in number of passengers.
  • This station is the second station after Venus Street Station to be named after a Street.
  • This station is the permanent Down Direction Terminus of Origin Line.
  • The Design of Exits B and C of this station adopts the New York City Subway exit design.
  • The existence of Pegasus Line is first announced at this station.
  • This Station is sister stations with Spring Stone Station, and the color scheme of this station alludes to Metropolis Terminal.

History[]

  • May 19 2020: This station began services alongside Origin Line, but Pegasus Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • February 14 2022: Pegasus Line is established.
  • December 13 2022: Exit D of this station has been relocated.[3]

Wineglass Isle is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is a subsidiary isle of Compass Island.

Location[]

Wineglass Isle is located to the northeast of Compass Island, the north of Two Sym Isle and the west of Lean Forest Island.
